note: Written in round 4 of backlog row 283 (2026-10-13). cabextract: version 1.11 (libmspack) in a Docker container with no network, on the files of manifest_cab.json; a member's 'cabextract' is the SHA-256 of what it unpacked, 'failed' where it reported an error for the member, null where it wrote no file for it (a name it would not write, or a member matched by no name). 'reader' is what solvers/metadata-forensics/readers_msi.py gave then: 'same', 'unknown', or a digest of its own where cabextract has none (stored bytes of a member cabextract did not write). 'decoders' names, per folder, the decoders that unpacked an LZX or Quantum folder. quantum_built: cabinets the test rebuilds with its mirror encoder; cabextract and 7zz 26.03 unpacked each to 'sha256' where 'valid', and refused each where not (matches over a frame's end).
